findings.problem: GET /rfqs/{id}/bids/{bid_id} weighs only membership plus keyed_by (bids.py:371), while GET /rfqs/{id}/bids (line 401) also requires rfq.edit or rfq.approve. A user whose rfq.edit was revoked keeps reading the bids they keyed by id, but loses them in the list: the same resource, two authorization rules.
findings.fix: Apply the list's rfq.edit-or-rfq.approve check in get_bid as well (one shared helper for both routes).

findings.problem: parseAmount re-implements lib/decimal.ts parseQuantity's locale normalisation (separators, strip group, swap decimal) line for line; only the final validity regex differs. Two copies of the locale parser drift the first time one is fixed.
findings.fix: Move the normalisation into lib/decimal.ts (e.g. a canonicalDecimal(input, locale)) and have parseQuantity and parseAmount each apply only their own validity check.
